doc.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
doc.interviewee: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams

title: Cage's birth in Franklin County and early music
summary: Cage says he was born in 1894 in Franklin County, Mississippi, and recalls a field band and his siblings playing accordion.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: It's so funny when you hear yourself talk on one of those things. It's just a little bit later, you know. It makes me nervous, I swear. Anyhow, where were you born at? I was born in Franklin County, Mississippi. Franklin County, Mississippi. What's the nearest town? Hamboys. Matthews was in the nearest big town. Yeah, but that's Adams, isn't it? Adams County. Yeah, it's in Mississippi, yeah. Yeah, that's to the west, I believe, frankly. Hamboys was made from Mississippi. Oh, yeah. And what year were you born? 1894. Remember the exact day? Well, May. No, not that exact day, but in May. In May. Well, happy birthday. Yeah. I used to say the 16th. I used to use that, but I wasn't sure of it. Well, you got three days to go, isn't it? Yes. Anyhow, what kind of music did you hear out there when you were growing up? I had a drum. Go get my wife. Oh, you got a wife still? Yes.
Well, we're going to have a field band. Yes. Yes. Well, did your family play music? Yes. I had a sister. Two sisters to play accordion. And one brother.
